g.text: Hypothetical groyne scheme: plan with beach widths (widths to scale)
Aims: keep the recreational beach at U; do not reduce supply to D.
U, just updrift of the groyne, gains 10 m: consistent with the
groyne trapping northward drift, so aim 1 is met.
D, downdrift, loses 8 m, far more than the 1 m lost at reference
C: reduced supply is a plausible cause, but aim 2 is not
C shows the wider change is small, but other site differences
could still contribute: overall success remains unproven.
Mean beach width before and after the groyne
